raw.description: Covenant adopted in 1966 by United Nations General Assembly resolution
raw.extract: The International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR) is a multilateral treaty adopted by the United Nations General Assembly (GA) on 16 December 1966 through GA. Resolution 2200A (XXI), and came into force on 3 January 1976. It commits its parties to work toward the granting of economic, social, and cultural rights (ESCR) to all individuals including those living in Non-Self-Governing and Trust Territories. The rights include labour rights, the right to health, the right to education, and the right to an adequate standard of living. As of November 2026, the Covenant has 174 parties. A further four countries, including the United States, have signed but not ratified the Covenant.
